description: Korean Housing and Urban Fund (주택도시기금) loan eligibility, 2026 rules from nhuf.molit.go.kr: buy = 내집마련 디딤돌 (income 60M / 70M first-time or 2+ children / 85M newlyweds, net assets 511M, price 500M / 600M, limit 200M / 240M / 320M, LTV 70%, first-time 80% outside the capital region), 신생아 특례 디딤돌 (birth within 2 years, income 130M or 200M dual with each ≤ 130M, price 900M, limit 400M), 청년 주택드림 디딤돌 (age ≤ 39, dream account 1 year and 10M + winning a sale, income 70M / 100M newlyweds, price 600M, limit 300M / 400M); jeonse = 버팀목 (income 50M / 60M two children / 75M newlyweds, net assets 345M, deposit 300M/200M or 400M/300M, limit 120M/80M or 250M/160M, 70% / 80% of deposit), 청년전용 버팀목 (19-34, 50M, deposit 300M, limit 150M or 120M under 25 single), 신생아 특례 버팀목 (deposit 500M/400M, limit 240M); monthly = 주거안정 월세대출 (deposit 100M, rent 600k, 14.4M). Returns each product with eligibility, blocking reasons, max loan and rate range, and the largest.
